WITH matched_records AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    COUNT(*) as rec_count
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(rec_count) as total_count
  FROM matched_records
),
with_fractions AS (
  SELECT 
    mr.zoneref,
    mr.insurstat,
    mr.rec_count,
    CAST(mr.rec_count AS REAL) / t.total_count as fraction
  FROM matched_records mr
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    insurstat,
    rec_count,
    fraction,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC) as rnk
  FROM with_fractions
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  insurstat,
  rec_count,
  fraction
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= (SELECT MAX(rnk) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10)
ORDER BY fraction DESC

alternatives.interpretation: "10th-highest" refers to row position 10 (not distinct fraction value), with ties broken arbitrarily before limiting
